mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LISTING ( LSTG_ID, MBR_CD, RENTAL_PTY_ID, LSTG_TYPE_CODE1, LSTG_TYPE_CODE2, LSTG_ADD, LSTG_ADD2, LSTG_EX_AREA, LSTG_GR_AREA, LSTG_ROOM_CNT, LSTG_ROOM_NUM, LSTG_NM, LSTG_DST, LSTG_TYPE_SALE, LSTG_LEASE, LSTG_LEASE_M, LSTG_LEASE_AMT, LSTG_FLOOR, LSTG_PARK_YN, LSTG_LAT, LSTG_LNG, LSTG_DEL, LSTG_REG_DATE, LSTG_PROD_STAT, LSTG_POSTAL, LSTG_FEE ) VALUES ( #{lstgId}, #{mbrCd}, #{rentalPtyId}, #{lstgTypeCode1}, #{lstgTypeCode2}, #{lstgAdd}, #{lstgAdd2}, #{lstgExArea}, #{lstgGrArea}, #{lstgRoomCnt}, #{lstgRoomNum}, #{lstgNm}, #{lstgDst}, #{lstgTypeSale}, #{lstgLease}, #{lstgLeaseM}, #{lstgLeaseAmt}, #{lstgFloor}, #{lstgParkYn}, #{lstgLat}, #{lstgLng}, 'N', SYSDATE, '001', #{lstgPostal}, #{lstgFee} )
mapper.select: SELECT B.BLDG_ID , B.RENTAL_PTY_ID , B.BLDG_NM , B.BLDG_ZIP_NO , B.BLDG_ADDR , B.BLDG_DTL_ADDR , U.UNIT_ID , U.BLDG_ID U_BLDG_ID , U.RENTAL_PTY_ID U_RENTAL_PTY_ID , U.UNIT_DSR_MNTH_RENT_AMT , U.UNIT_DSR_SALE_AMT , U.UNIT_DPST_AMT , U.UNIT_FLR_NO , U.UNIT_ROOM , U.MBR_CD , U.UNIT_CMAR , U.UNIT_XUAR FROM BUILDING B, UNIT U WHERE B.BLDG_ID = U.BLDG_ID AND B.RENTAL_PTY_ID = #{rentalPtyId} AND B.BLDG_ID = #{bldgId}

SELECT B.BLDG_ID , B.RENTAL_PTY_ID , B.BLDG_NM , B.BLDG_ZIP_NO , B.BLDG_ADDR , B.BLDG_DTL_ADDR FROM BUILDING B WHERE B.RENTAL_PTY_ID = #{rentalPtyId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM UNIT U WHERE U.BLDG_ID = B.BLDG_ID )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT B.REPR_TEL_NO , B.BROK_NM , B.BROK_ADDR1 , B.BROK_ADDR2 , B.REPR_NM , B.MBR_CD , ( SELECT F.FILE_PATH_URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.FILE_SOURCE_ID = B.MBR_CD AND F.FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'BROKER' AND F.DOC_TYPE_CD = 'NAMECARD_MAIN' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS businessCardUrl , ( 6371 * ACOS( COS(#{lat} * (3.141592653589793 / 180)) * COS(B.BROK_LAT * (3.141592653589793 / 180)) * COS((B.BROK_LNG - #{lng}) * (3.141592653589793 / 180)) + SIN(#{lat} * (3.141592653589793 / 180)) * SIN(B.BROK_LAT * (3.141592653589793 / 180)) ) ) AS distance FROM BROKER B WHERE B.BROK_LAT IS NOT NULL AND B.BROK_LNG IS NOT NULL ) A WHERE A.distance <= #{radiusKm} ORDER BY A.distance ASC

SELECT LSTG_ID , MBR_CD , LSTG_TYPE_CODE2 , LSTG_ADD , LSTG_ADD2 , LSTG_EX_AREA , LSTG_GR_AREA , LSTG_ROOM_CNT , LSTG_ROOM_NUM , LSTG_DST , LSTG_TYPE_SALE , LSTG_LEASE , LSTG_LEASE_M , LSTG_LEASE_AMT , LSTG_FLOOR , LSTG_PARK_YN , LSTG_LAT , LSTG_LNG , LSTG_DEL , LSTG_REG_DATE , LSTG_PROD_STAT , LSTG_NM , LSTG_TYPE_CODE1 , RENTAL_PTY_ID , LSTG_POSTAL , LSTG_FEE FROM LISTING WHERE LSTG_ADD = #{lstgAdd} AND RENTAL_PTY_ID = #{rentalPtyId} AND LSTG_DEL = 'N'

SELECT LSTG_ID, MBR_CD, RENTAL_PTY_ID, LSTG_TYPE_CODE1, LSTG_TYPE_CODE2, LSTG_ADD, LSTG_ADD2, LSTG_EX_AREA, LSTG_GR_AREA, LSTG_ROOM_CNT, LSTG_ROOM_NUM, LSTG_NM, LSTG_DST, LSTG_TYPE_SALE, LSTG_LEASE, LSTG_LEASE_M, LSTG_LEASE_AMT, LSTG_FLOOR, LSTG_PARK_YN, LSTG_LAT, LSTG_LNG, LSTG_DEL, LSTG_REG_DATE, LSTG_PROD_STAT, LSTG_POSTAL FROM LISTING WHERE LSTG_ID = #{lstgId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LISTING SET LSTG_TYPE_CODE1 = #{lstgTypeCode1}, LSTG_TYPE_CODE2 = #{lstgTypeCode2}, LSTG_ADD = #{lstgAdd}, LSTG_ADD2 = #{lstgAdd2}, LSTG_EX_AREA = #{lstgExArea}, LSTG_GR_AREA = #{lstgGrArea}, LSTG_ROOM_CNT = #{lstgRoomCnt}, LSTG_ROOM_NUM = #{lstgRoomNum}, LSTG_NM = #{lstgNm}, LSTG_DST = #{lstgDst}, LSTG_TYPE_SALE = #{lstgTypeSale}, LSTG_LEASE = #{lstgLease}, LSTG_LEASE_M = #{lstgLeaseM}, LSTG_LEASE_AMT = #{lstgLeaseAmt}, LSTG_FLOOR = #{lstgFloor}, LSTG_PARK_YN = #{lstgParkYn}, LSTG_LAT = #{lstgLat}, LSTG_LNG = #{lstgLng}, LSTG_DEL = #{lstgDel}, LSTG_PROD_STAT = #{lstgProdStat}, LSTG_FEE = #{lstgFee} WHERE LSTG_ID = #{lstgId}
mapper.select: SELECT FAC_OPT_NM , FAC_OPT_TYPE_CD , FAC_OPT_ID , FAC_OPT_DESC , FAC_TYPE_CC_CD , FAC_TYPE_GRP_CD FROM FACILITY_OPTION ORDER BY FAC_TYPE_GRP_CD, FAC_OPT_NM
